perfilTexto: I'm Thales Alves Boardman, a Junior Web Developer with hands-on experience in the public sector, working on the development and maintenance of institutional websites using WordPress and Drupal. I have contributed to the creation of internal forms, landing pages, news collection automation for the City Hall, email collection and classification systems, standardized email signatures, testing of the Femictec website, and the new municipal intranet.
perfilTexto2: I also have experience with CodeIgniter 4, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, Python, and basic image editing. I am committed to delivering functional, organized, responsive, and accessible solutions while continuously improving my technical skills. I am currently seeking an opportunity to join a technology team, contribute with my knowledge, and continue growing as a Web Developer.

cuscoDescricao: Cusco Website – City Hall - Creation of internal pages using Drupal, CSS, and the institutional layout.
formulariosDescricao: City Hall Forms - Development of custom forms for different departments. Some forms are public, while others are internal and are frequently opened and closed, making it difficult to provide a single permanent link. In total, I developed 68 forms for the City Hall.
githubProjeto1: • Institutional Email Signature - Signature generator used by public employees.
githubProjeto2: • WordPress Website (Mixmob) - Website creation, configuration, and navigation improvements.
githubProjeto3: • Automation for news classification using Python, the Clarity API, and Google Analytics API, exporting all information to a spreadsheet.
githubProjeto4: • Automation for email collection and classification. Since keyword-based classification was not sufficiently accurate, part of the process was manually completed to separate important emails from spam.
intranetDescricao: Project currently under development, presented through a video produced by the team. Initial development of the new institutional intranet using CodeIgniter 4. I contributed to implementing:
intranet7: • "Leave without saving" and "Delete extension" warning dialogs
intranet8: • Buttons to increase and decrease the font size across the website
intranet9: • Additional options menu for extensions (copy email, edit, and delete)
intranet10: • Success, warning, and error notification messages
intranetObjetivo: The project aims to replace the previous intranet, which had outdated content and poor usability.
curriculoProjeto: • My Resume - Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and published on GitHub.
obraFacilProjeto: • "Obra Fácil" Landing Page (Instituto Evoluir Project) - Course project developed following HTML and CSS best practices.
estoqueprodutos: • Product Inventory – A project developed in Java with Spring Boot to practice developing and unit testing a REST API. The application allows users to register, list, search for, and delete products. Unit tests using JUnit and Mockito were also implemented to validate the system's core functionalities.
sistemadespessas: • Expense Approval System – This project was developed in Java to demonstrate the *Chain of Responsibility* design pattern. The system simulates expense approval within a company. Each approver has a specific limit: the Manager can approve expenses up to R$ 500, the Director up to R$ 2,000, and the President up to R$ 10,000. Amounts exceeding this limit are rejected.
bancojava: • Java Bank – A mock bank application created in VS Code using Java; it was built in a simple, straightforward manner to put into practice what I learned and the required concepts (Java banking and Object-Oriented Programming).
jogomemoria: • Memory Game – A memory game built using VS Code and JavaScript; icons were used instead of images.
projetohistoria: • History Project – This is a personal project of mine: a website where you can read about historical events and learn more about them. It is currently under development. In the future, I plan to add user profiles, a database, and more stories—with greater depth—all built using React.
